title: fix: C_Login silently ignores CKU_SO userType
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c, C_Login only handles userType==CKU_USER (PIV login path). There is no else-if or else for CKU_SO (Security Officer). If C_Login is called with CKU_SO, execution falls through without updating session state (s->logged_in stays 0), but the function may return CKR_OK depending on the fall-through path.

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.16 requires C_Login(CKU_SO) to either authenticate the SO or return an appropriate error (CKR_PIN_INCORRECT, CKR_USER_TYPE_INVALID, etc.).

Impact: Any application that tries SO login (e.g., for PIN management) gets a silent no-op or incorrect return code, then proceeds thinking it is logged in as SO when it is not.

Fix: Add explicit handling for CKU_SO: either implement SO login if the backend supports it, or return CKR_USER_TYPE_INVALID with a comment explaining why SO login is not supported on this device type.
